# Sales Career Coach Skill for Muse

Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT), listed here with credit to its creator @mbfinotti. A career strategist for one sales candidate: breaking into SDR/BDR seats, converting to AE, or choosing the next move — across B2B SaaS and commission-heavy B2C (real estate, insurance, solar, auto). It runs a structured interview first, then builds a gap roadmap with quantified track-record evidence, mock interview exercises (cold call, sell-me-this-pen, candidate-authored 30-60-90), employer diligence, and offer evaluation anchored to dated benchmarks (Bridge Group, RepVue, NAR). Candidate side only. Honest notes: a strategy coach, not a job search agent — it doesn't source listings, fill applications, or generate resume files; advice is only as good as the benchmarks' freshness — verify current market data before a real negotiation; employer-side hiring is handled by the sibling skill sales-hiring, not this one. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
